Name: More Tree Seeds(Including Mushroom Trees)
Author: 1A2B3C4DABCD
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]You can customize the settings via the Generic Mod Config Menu or by editing the `config.json` file in the `MoreTreeSeeds` folder.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]Held seeds and nearby planting are rolled once per day when you sleep.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]This mod only changes those chances—it does not give trees seeds mid-day. [/color][color=#ffff00]Sleep once for the new rates to apply.[/color]
Additionally, shaking a mushroom tree now has a chance to drop mushrooms.

[color=#D4D4D8][b]Shake Seed Multiplier[/b]: Multiplies the daily chace a mature tree holds a seed.
[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][color=#D4D4D8]If set to 20: Vanilla (5%) * 20 = 100%[/color][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]If set to 10: Vanilla (5%) * 10 = 50%[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][b]Chop Seed Multiplier[/b]: Multiplies the chance of a seed when chopping a tree.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]MushRoom Trees Shake For Seeds[/b]: Enable this to let them too, using the Shake Seed Multiplier above.
[b]Disable Nearby Seeds[/b]: When enabled, trees will not auto-plant seeds on nearby tiles.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Unzip the file and put the  MoreTreeSeeds folder inside the Stardew Valley\Mods folder.
Requires SMAPI 4.0+

Manifest.Name: More Tree Seeds
Manifest.Description: Increases shake/chop seed chances and can stop trees from auto-planting seeds nearby.
